Class BuildingCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.model.card.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.model.card.buildingCard.BuildingCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
AddPointsEndGame, ArtistEventFoodBonus, DoubleBuildersPoints, ExtraUpperCardAfterActions, FeedingSaleCharType, FoodBonusOrderTile, FoodPerInventorPair, FoodPerSet, HuntingEventFoodPointsBonus, PointsPerCharType, PointsPerSet, ShamanEventDouble, ShamanNoLoss, ShamanStarsBonus
public abstract class BuildingCard extends Card
Base class for all building cards. A building card is bought by the current player at the cost of cost food (reduced by the player's building-sale discount, never below zero) and grants points victory points at the end of the game. Concrete subclasses extend the base behavior by overriding one or more of the lifecycle hooks (onCardPicked(GameModel, CharacterCard), onEventResolving(GameModel, EventCard, Player), onOwnTurnEnding(GameModel), grantsExtraUpperCardAfterActions(), onGameEnding(GameModel, Player)) and/or resolveEffect(GameModel) to apply their rule-specific bonuses.

      public BuildingCard(int cardId, int era, int minPlayers, int cost, int points)
      Creates a building card.
      Parameters:
      cardId - unique card id
      era - era the card belongs to (1, 2 or 3)
      minPlayers - minimum player count required for this card to be in the deck
      cost - food cost to acquire the building (before the building-sale discount)
      points - base victory points granted at the end of the game
